description:
Natural Trilobite Fossil
Stone Matrix Specimen
Paleozoic Era
This impressive trilobite fossil is preserved within its natural stone matrix, displaying the characteristic segmented exoskeleton of these ancient marine arthropods. The specimen features a well-defined thoracic region and cephalon, highlighted by a hand-tooled border prepared in the surrounding sedimentary stone to emphasize the fossil's biological form. As a representative of the Paleozoic Era, this piece offers a tangible connection to Earth's prehistoric oceans and early biological diversity.
Natural fossil specimen embedded in sedimentary stone matrix
Detailed thoracic segments and cephalon structure visible on the dorsal surface
Manually prepared border carved into the matrix to highlight the central specimen
Dimensions: 6.5" L x 6" W x 1" H; Weight: 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fossil is structurally sound within the matrix with no visible structural repairs or artificial reconstructions. The stone matrix remains solid with natural mineral variations and ochre-toned oxidation consistent with geological aging. The reverse side exhibits natural stone textures and fossiliferous fragments.

description: This lot includes 9 natural mineral specimens primarily composed of selenite, a crystalline form of gypsum. The crystals display characteristic striated and bladed formations and are in raw, unpolished condition with some natural edge chipping. These selenite specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, metaphysical applications, or educational purposes.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping

cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description: This mixed lot includes a variety of collectible rocks, minerals, crystals, fossils, and geological specimens. The assortment features rough mineral samples such as amethyst, rose quartz, and calcite, along with fossilized coral and shell pieces. Included are both tumbled and raw stones, as well as unique items like a vintage glass insulator and a small plastic box containing microfossils or shells. The collection presents a wide range of colors including greens, yellows, purples, reds, and neutrals, with sizes ranging from small fragments to palm-sized specimens. Conditions vary from rough and raw to lightly polished, with some stones exhibiting natural holes, fossil imprints, or unique mineral formations. This lot contains vintage and modern rocks, geodes, marble, and more, suitable for collectors, educational use, or craft projects.

shipping.policy:
Shipping:
Shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). Orders will be shipped within
5 business days
(Monday-Friday) of payment. However, we make every effort to ship sooner. Shipping may be delayed in the event of unforeseen business closure for holidays, disasters, etc.
Our shipping software shops for the best shipping option for your order. The carrier that the item is listed with may not be the carrier with which the item(s) ship.
Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box, and we are contacted prior to payment. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Because of how our carriers charge for shipping, item weight is calculated based on the dimensional weight and not the actual weight of the item. This can potentially add to the shipping charge of combined orders if larger shipping materials are required.
Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.
You will need a physical street address to receive your packages.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
Attention:
Goodwill Middle TN is not responsible for lost or stolen packages after delivery to the customer has been confirmed with tracking information. Contact FedEx or USPS for further information.

description:
Cross
3501 Chrome Set - Ball Point Pen & Mechanical Pencil
Vintage, 2 Pieces with Original Box
This vintage Cross 3501 chrome writing set represents the classic mid-century corporate gift aesthetic, featuring a lustrous chrome finish and the iconic slim silhouette for which A.T. Cross is renowned. These specific instruments are personalized with the General Electric (GE) logo in enamel on the clips, identifying them as a corporate commemorative or award set. Both pieces were manufactured in the United States, maintaining the brand's legacy of high-quality craftsmanship.
Verified "CROSS MADE IN USA" stamped on the cap of each instrument
GE (General Electric) corporate logo enamel emblems on clips
Set includes: One ballpoint pen and one mechanical pencil - 2 pieces total
Presented in original Cross gray textured gift box with satin lining
Instrument length: 5.25 inches
Condition:
Very good vintage condition with bright chrome finish and minimal surface wear. The ballpoint pen is untested and may require a new ink cartridge for use. The mechanical pencil appears functional with lead present. The original gift box shows light exterior shelf wear and age-related yellowing to the interior satin lining. Emblems are intact and well-defined.
